story: A textile buyer orders 12.5 square metres of exhibition fabric.
The studio gifts a colour swatch while the buyer pays the carrier directly.
Three free seal samples travel on seller-booked freight recharged to the buyer.
The buyer says freight collect and the quotation says prepaid and added.
The seller confirms free samples but the item price from the earlier quote is still present.
The quote calls a mold trial chargeable and contains no sample charge other than the courier fee.
The buyer asks whether the sample fee can offset production but the seller has not replied.
A packaging buyer earns a sample fee credit only upon the first paid order of 500 boxes.

overrides.sample_credit: USD 8 credited on the first paid order of at least 500 boxes.

story: No courier rate has been issued and the buyer requests a document for review.
The customer asks for a discount but the signed quote does not yet state the deduction.
The proposed credit note was entered as a discount and exceeds all order charges.
Packaging printed to order is paid in three equal milestones with an explicit rounding residual.
A revised deposit increased from 30 to 50 percent and the original balance was left in place.
A partial length of tape produces half a yen and the payable amount follows the quoted yen precision.
A broker enters fractional yen for an insurance charge.
finding: Fees and discount must use currency precision

story: The confirmed shipment quote itemizes transit cover separately from carriage.
A prototype fixture includes a one-time stencil setup charge in addition to the sample and carrier.
The supplier offers ex-stock samples and has not confirmed the pickup date.
The quote was reissued after its commercial validity deadline without updating the validity term.
A spot quotation is valid on the date of issue for immediate customer confirmation.
A department store invoices headquarters and delivers samples to a forwarder's warehouse.
A Japanese trading firm's native legal name must survive both output formats.
Black and natural variants were entered under the same SKU.
The quantity is agreed but the source never says whether the price is per set or per piece.
The quote quotes USD while the buyer requests settlement in EUR and there is no agreed basis.
The buyer asks for an image PI to match a variant and its only product photo is missing.
finding: Each image PI line requires a product image

story: The buyer forwards amended payment instructions against a beneficiary the factory has not verified.
A draft was reconstructed from memory and the operator has supplied no source reference.
The buyer disputes the promised delivery date after the supplier entered it in the draft.
A stock sample is explicitly unchanged and has no condition for a future credit.
A line total was confused with the unit price and awaits confirmation.
Each adhesive strip trial line extends to half a cent and is billed independently.
